info.name: Medionic HealthCare+ Complete & Production-Ready API Collection
info.description:
Official, comprehensive Postman Collection for Medionic HealthCare+ API ecosystem.

✨ Features:
- 100% Endpoints covered across Patient, Doctor, MR, Admin, Pharmacy (v1), AI Diagnostics, Payments & Telehealth.
- Auto-token capturing for all roles upon login/registration.
- Auto-ID capturing (appointmentId, prescriptionId, orderId, medicineId, invoiceId, branchId, etc.).
- Pre-seeded ready-to-test 1-click accounts.
- Environment/Collection variables pre-configured for instant zero-configuration testing.
